cases.headline: Hold the note. The documents do not say the same thing.
cases.body: White House and AP describe an announcement: 17 fields, 100-year rights, NABEP. The 65 billion barrels are field reserves in that announcement; the 46 billion barrels on the fact sheet are U.S. territorial reserves — different figures. AP attributes the 65 billion barrels' prior Russian/Chinese operators to the White House; that sentence is not in the stored fact sheet. OFAC, if in this batch, is a license list — not that contract. Licenses on the OFAC recording include: 5Y, 24A, 30B, 46D, 47B, 48C, 49A, 50C, 51D, 52B, 54C, 55A, 61A, 62. Do not write that OFAC authorised the concessions. Do not pick a NABEP ranking.
